name: Marielle Clemens
original_name: マリエル・クレメンス
source:
Occupation: Unemployed
Hobbies: Basking in the sun
Skills: Recognizing medicine just from the taste alone
Likes: Sweet things
Dislikes: Her illness

A woman with an illness that lets her live only up to the age 20. However, she feels like light is finally shining upon her dark world when she gets an invitation from the celestial world. Believing that she will be completely healed from her illness, she went to Caelum Urbs, only to wake up in a completely white room. Marielle does not want to participate in the Closed GAME, and being unsure whether she can actually survive there, she has been thrown into the depths of despair once again.
